opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return). Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, local authorities. Only one application at a time per organisation.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines. Operating/core cost grants typically 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; capital and project grants typically 10-20% of costs (local community capital projects capped at £30,000).

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs, the organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs, the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million (regardless of annual income). Must be a UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation with at least one year's accounts. Apply via Expression of Interest form.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Expressions of Interest can be submitted all year round with no deadlines, reviewed on a rolling basis. Covers operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities.
